newsitem.title: FRANCE: Three wheat ships expected in Rouen by August 28.
newsitem.headline: Three wheat ships expected in Rouen by August 28.

text.p: Three ships were expected in Rouen by August 28 to load a combined 34,000 tonnes of wheat, port officials said on Tuesday. The destination was not specified.
In Rouen, four ships were currently loading a total of 45,000 tonnes of wheat destined for Cuba, Italy, Libya and Poland, they said.
Two vessels were also loading a combined 12,000 tonnes of barley destined for Italy and Turkey.
